raw_text: Interface looks nice but is cluttered once you have more than a handful of themes. Needs better grouping.
Needs a better way to merge duplicate feedback automatically. Doing it by hand takes a while.
Sentiment analysis mislabels sarcasm and mixed comments, which skews our reports.
Too many settings spread across different menus. I always have to hunt for things.
Account got locked and support took two days to respond. Our entire product team couldn't work. Unacceptable for a business tool.
Every time we run theme clustering the whole workspace becomes unusable for a few minutes. Not great during working hours.
After the latest redesign I can't find half the features. The new navigation is a step backward, please bring back the old layout option.
The way themes are visualised as clusters is genuinely helpful for presentations.
Really smooth sign in experience, even on mobile.
Good design overall, though dark mode has some contrast problems in the sidebar.
Very few issues. Release notes are clear and updates don't break anything.
Exports of big roadmaps take so long that the browser tab sometimes crashes.
Loads quickly on both desktop and tablet. No complaints.
Logging in with Google takes one click. No issues in six months.
Would like competitor tracking features, so we can compare our feedback themes against market trends.
AI generated PRDs appear in under a minute, a huge time saver compared to writing them manually.
Tables are hard to read on large monitors, text is tiny and cannot be zoomed without breaking the layout.
Duplicate feedback items appear after every sync with our helpdesk. Cleaning them up wastes time.
Integration with Slack keeps disconnecting silently, so we miss alerts. Had to reconnect it three times this month.
Version history for PRDs is basic. I'd like to see who changed what, line by line.
Comments vanish on PRDs when two people edit at the same time.
Rarely encounter bugs, and the team patches issues fast. Great support.
Never had a login problem. Solid and secure.
Few minor bugs here and there, nothing that stops me from working.
Password reset emails never arrive. I've tried three times and checked spam, finally had to contact support.
Roadmap sharing is limited. There's no way to publish a read only view for customers.
Love it. Adding a calendar sync for roadmap milestones would be awesome.
Not the fastest app I've used but not the slowest. Acceptable for the price.
AI sometimes hallucinates feedback quotes that don't exist in my data. Have to double check everything.
Five stars for usability. Onboarding walked me through importing feedback and generating my first PRD in minutes.
Notification badges don't clear after reading. Cosmetic but annoying.
Login page doesn't show a clear error when the password is wrong, just reloads.
No way to bulk edit feedback tags. Doing it one by one is tedious.
Initial page load feels heavy, probably too many scripts. Subsequent pages are fine.
Quick and snappy. Syncing with our feedback source was done in minutes.
The app freezes when I open large feedback imports. Have to reload the browser to continue.
Clear visual hierarchy, nice typography, and the colour coding for priority is spot on.
Really responsive, even on our slow office wifi. Good engineering.
No lag at all in our team of 40. Very smooth experience.
Impressive speed for AI features, summaries and user stories generate faster than the competitor we trialled.
This is the best feedback tool I've tried. Please add GitHub integration and it would be unbeatable.
Login works fine, but I wish there was an option for biometric login on mobile.
Decent UI, a bit of a learning curve at the start. After a week it clicked.
Fast, even with thousands of feedback entries. Searching and filtering feel instant.
Stable and reliable. We have used it daily for months without a crash.
Solid product but missing a native Jira integration. We use a workaround with CSV exports which is clunky.
Page layout shifts while loading so I often click the wrong button. Annoying.
Buggy after the last update. User stories disappear from my backlog until I refresh the page.
Super easy to use, I'm not technical and had no problems at all.
Really useful so far. My main wish is the ability to add attachments to feedback items.
The CSV import fails on files with commas inside quotes. Had to clean everything manually.
Search sometimes returns no results even for words I know exist.
Lost a full PRD after an error message popped up while saving. There was no autosave or recovery. Very frustrating.
Slick and responsive design. Our stakeholders were impressed when I shared the roadmap view.
SSO integration was painless. IT approved it quickly and we rolled it out to 60 people in a day.
Great stability, and when something does go wrong the error messages actually help.
Would give 5 stars if the UI were more customisable, but the defaults are decent.
Performance is generally good, with occasional lag during peak hours.
Magic links and SSO make onboarding contractors a breeze.
The product is stable most of the time but occasionally gives vague error messages.
Secure and simple. Two factor authentication was easy to set up.
Authentication is okay. Session timeout is a bit short for my taste.
Needs more export options. PDF is fine but we'd like Word and Markdown too.
Notifications and the activity feed lag behind by several minutes, so we get outdated information.
Great for turning feedback into requirements. Slack notifications would make it a perfect 5 stars.
Dashboard is painfully slow with our data volume. Takes up to 30 seconds to load, which is unacceptable for a daily tool.
Loading times have gotten worse over the last few releases. Hope they address it.
The dashboard gives me everything I need in one view. Clean, modern, and not overwhelming.
Invite flow is confusing, new teammates get an error unless they use the exact email I invited.
UI is okay but nothing special. Does the job.
Mostly bug free, though the Safari experience has some rendering glitches.
Dashboard timed out three times during our quarterly planning session. Very embarrassing in front of leadership.
Cannot export feedback with theme tags to our BI tool. That limits how much we can do with the data.
Had one error with exports, retried and it worked. Fine overall.
Good tool, would like to see a public API for custom integrations.
Beautiful interface, our designers and PMs both picked it up instantly. Feels like the tool was made by people who actually do product work.
Missing role based access control, which is a dealbreaker for our security team.
Very good value. Adding scheduled reports would be the cherry on top.
Can't stay logged in on my phone, it asks me to sign in every time I open the app.
Standard auth, nothing special but nothing broken.
Disappointed that there is no Zapier or webhook support. Automation options are very limited.
The automated user story feature is fantastic. I'd love to see support for custom story templates in the future.
Good security features, SAML support and audit logs gave our compliance team confidence.
Speed is decent. Could be better when switching between workspaces.
Mobile experience is poor. Buttons overlap on my phone and I can't review PRDs on the go.
Forced logouts are frequent, I lose my work if I don't save constantly.
A multi language option would help our international teams.
Switching between accounts is awkward. I have to log out fully to use a second workspace login.
Decent feature set for an early product, but advanced analytics are missing.
Lacks integrations with the tools we actually use. No Slack, no Linear, no Confluence. Hard to justify for our team.
Love the drag and drop roadmap, way more intuitive than the spreadsheet we were using.
2FA lockout with no recovery codes provided. Had to wait for support to reset it, lost half a day.
The editor feels cramped, and there's no focus mode for writing long requirements.
Okta SSO setup docs are outdated and our admin spent hours figuring out the right settings.
Would prefer more granular permissions, but login itself is reliable.
Report generation is slow and sometimes times out. Support told us to try smaller date ranges.
It's fine for small teams but I'm not sure it would hold up for enterprise volumes.
Icons aren't labelled and some of them are really not obvious. Hovering for tooltips every time gets old.
Roadmap export generates a corrupted file about half the time. We have to retry multiple times.
Found a bug and support had it fixed in 24 hours. Fantastic service.
